items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: No not Jimmy Cobb, out of Philadelphia.

ctx.x: No not Jimmy Cobb, out of Philadelphia. But anyway they had a wonderful rhythm section together. As a matter of fact they scared me. Because when I heard them, it’s like you listen to someone play and you say hey, you know, I can do that, or I can do it better. But when I heard them I didn’t think I could do it better.
